title: What If One Cloud Region Went Dark? Amazon's Did in 2025

scenes.text: What if one block of the internet's servers went dark? On October 20, 2025, it did.
Early that Monday, a database service in Amazon's Northern Virginia region lost its address.
A bug in the system that manages its DNS left that address blank, so apps could not find the service.
Snapchat, Fortnite, Venmo, Reddit and Alexa all stumbled or went down.
The blank address was fixed within hours, but new servers kept failing to start and the trouble rippled on.
Some problems lasted around 15 hours. One software bug in one region, and dozens of apps you use went quiet.

description:
What if one cloud region went dark?
